1.name: Part 1
1.ov: The first feature-length episode focuses on The Beatles' early years in Liverpool to their 1964 World Tour.  Also featured is the world premiere of the first new Beatles song in 25 years, Free As A Bird.

1.name: Part 2
1.ov: The second feature-length episode focuses on the pressures of Beatlemania to Sgt. Pepper. Also featured is the world premiere of the second new Beatles song in 25 years, Real Love.

1.name: Part 3
1.ov: The third (and originally final) feature-length episode of the focuses on the time between death of Brian Epstein to their breakup in 1970.

1.name: Episode Nine
1.ov: This new episode includes unseen behind-the-scenes footage of Paul, George and Ringo coming together between 1994 and 1995 to work on 'The Anthology' and reflecting on their shared life as the Beatles.
